pages.title: Warding Wings
pages.text: The ward grows stronger as a dragon matures. Thornfeather magic answers the wounds the ward cannot prevent.$(br2)Joined together, they offer a little more protection to companions bound for dangerous places.$(br2)Not a drop of blood on these wings of freedom is shed in vain.

pages.title: Protection and Retaliation
pages.text: Grants 2 to 6 armor according to growth stage and retains the Thornfeather Charm's retaliation.$(br2)Its armor bonus stacks with other armor accessories, but it cannot be worn with a Thornfeather Charm. The owner and allies are safe from retaliation.
